description: Defines the TailLogCommand struct, which conforms to the ParsableCommand protocol, used to tail recent log transcripts by retrieving the latest entries from TranscriptsStore.

classes.name: TailLogCommand
classes.description: A command to tail recent transcript logs, conforming to ParsableCommand.
